blocks.text: You can edit a resource tag to change basic information, or add and remove resources from the tag.

blocks.item: Resource groups are replaced by resource tags for Endpoint DLP. Any resource groups that you have already configured are automatically converted to resource tag groups. All policies that previously used resource groups are automatically updated to use the converted resource tag groups.
If your organization has licensed Endpoint Context but not Endpoint DLP, you do not have the option to create tags for network shares, network printers, or removable storage devices.

blocks.text: To edit a DLP and endpoint resource tag:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > Endpoint DLP > Endpoint DLP Resources.
On the DLP & Endpoint Resources page:
Edit a network share tag
On the Network Share Tags page (Data Security > Endpoint DLP > Endpoint DLP Resources > Network Share Tags):
Locate a network share tag in the list, then click Edit.
The Edit Tag - Network Shares window appears.
In the Edit Tag - Network Shares window:
Enter the following Basic information:
Name: The name of the network share tag
Description: (Optional) A description of the network share tag
Select the network shares you want to add to or remove from the tag, then click Save.
See image.
The updated tag appears in the list of network share tags on the Network Share Tags page.
Edit a network printers tag
On the Printer Tags page (Data Security > Endpoint DLP > Endpoint DLP Resources > Printer Tags):
Locate a printer tag in the list, then click Edit.
The Edit Tag - Printers window appears.
In the Edit Tag - Printers window:
Enter the following Basic information:
Name: The name of the printer tag
Description: (Optional) A description of the printer tag
Select the network printers you want to add to or remove from the tag, then click Save.
See image.
The new tag appears in the list of printer tags on the Printer Tags page.
Edit a removable storage device tag
On the Removable Storage Device Tags (Data Security > Endpoint DLP > Endpoint DLP Resources > Removable Storage Device Tags) page:
Locate a printer tag in the list, then click Edit.
The Edit Tag - Removable Storage Devices window appears.
In the Edit Tag - Removable Storage Devices window:
Enter the following Basic information:
Name: The name of the storage device tag
Description: (Optional) A description of the storage device tag
Select the storage devices you want to add to or remove from the tag, then click Save.
See image.
The updated tag appears in the list of removable storage device tags on the Removable Storage Device Tags page.
Edit an endpoint application tag
To access this feature, contact your Zscaler Account team.

The Endpoint Application Tags tab contains both prebuilt lists of applications by category or theme from Zscaler, such as “Certificate Pinned” or “AI Browsers”, but can also contain custom application lists specific to your organization. You can click Edit on an existing customized prebuilt list.
On the Endpoint Application Tags page (Data Security > Endpoint DLP > Endpoint DLP Resources > Endpoint Application Tags):
Locate an endpoint application tag in the list, then click Edit.
The Edit Endpoint Application Tag drawer opens.
In the Edit Endpoint Application Tag drawer:
Enter the following basic information:
Name: The name of the application tag
Description: (Optional) A description of the application tag
In the Endpoint Applications drop-down menu, select or remove applications from the tag, then click Apply.
See image.
Click Save.
The updated tag appears in the list of application tags on the Endpoint Application Tags page.
Activate your changes.
